title: FatterWall
tagline: System cards, messages and a game stream float in the corner of my office.
what: A projector installation that turns the corner above my desk into an ambient display. Live system cards, messages and a friend's game stream look like they are floating across two walls instead of sitting inside a bright rectangle.
built: Solved the four-corner warp in CSS so a crooked two-wall throw becomes one square display
Made a calibration page on my main monitor so the mouse never has to enter the projector
Built a mouse fence that bounces the real pointer away from the wall display
Added message, live-vitals and game-stream views, plus a self-healing wireless cast path
progress: Three views and both the direct-cable and wireless paths are working.

making.problem: A normal projected desktop looks like a washed-out monitor and steals the mouse. I wanted the wall itself to feel like the display.
how: The page draws only light on black, so the unlit part disappears into the wall
A projective transform pins the page to four measured corners across the two-wall throw
The control page moves those corners from my main monitor while a mouse fence protects the projector
The same wall page can arrive through a direct cable or a wireless video cast

broke.title: The cable still needed a menu
broke.body: I added a wireless cast that finds the projector again after a power cycle, so the wall can heal without a cable or input menu.

credits: Display, calibration, mouse fence, views and cast path by me

moment.what: When the room is dim, the projector's black disappears and the clock, messages and live cards read like light sitting directly on the wall.
